text:
On my daily table, set over the sea,

there are the fish prepared by Alberto

and the fish marinated by Fuensanta.

Wine and bread, with the sweetest delicacy

made in these fields.


Meat does not come to my table here.

The fish that on fragrant embers concentrates

its most joyful juices

feeds my days of dreaming leisure.


My friends keep watch with solicitous care,

offering what is discreet to the palate.

Discreet and wise, perfect knowers

of the Levantine table.


A delicate transmutation of this landscape

is the table that Alberto with Fuensanta

daily fills for me with gifts.


I bite the Mar Menor

and swallow its blood!




The Poems of Mar Menor

, 1959

translation.title: Still Life
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the table as a transmutation of the Mar Menor landscape, ending in the startling sea-blood image.
